name: Timocreon of Rhodes
bio: Timocreon of Rhodes was a lyric poet of the early fifth century BC, remembered above all for the invective verses in which he attacked Themistocles. Paton’s Index of Authors dates him to the 5th century BC.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fifth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XIII: 31.

poems.title: Book XIII, 31
poems.author: Timocreon of Rhodes
poems.text: This nonsense from Ceos has reached me against my wish.
